text: The first season of MarriageToxin ends today. I loved it and I'm already excited for season 2 next year! My only complaint is that Gero never showed up barefoot in any scene 😭
What a beautiful view! Here's Sunraku sitting on a tree branch. Do u think he's mad?

You can still see everything we did this month! There are more characters than the ones shown in this image. Also, don't forget that u can read the comic starring Nakamura and Hirose, the most famous couple of the month ❤️
We're ending this special with Shoto Todoroki relaxing after an intense match! ⚽️ Which one was your favorite?
Pinned: Hey everyone! You can already read Making You Feel Better! Nakamura's in the school infirmary, but Hirose knows exactly how to cheer him up. It all starts with a little foot massage 😉
